look: 温暖的二维动画风格，凌晨深夜的室内，一盏暖光台灯与电脑屏幕的冷光照明。
setting: 凌晨深夜的英文环境书房：窗外是漆黑的夜空，室内昏暗，只有一盏暖光台灯和电脑屏幕的冷光照亮桌面，整段画面保持深夜氛围。显示器上是英文聊天界面，环境中出现的任何文字（屏幕界面、书脊、标签）都是英文。第一镜中，Claude娘独自坐在桌前，左手托着脸，右手轻放在桌面上，不同时操作鼠标，面对电脑另一端的画外用户；第二镜从稍偏侧的角度以中景拍摄：她突然从椅子上站起来，扭过头来看向镜头方向，露出邪魅的微笑。
constraints: 讽刺短剧，延续之前Claude娘视频的封禁反转。开场环境固定为凌晨深夜的英文环境：窗外漆黑，室内只有台灯与屏幕光，不能画成白天或傍晚；画面中如出现任何文字，只能是英文，不出现中文字。全片仅一个场景、一个生成片段，内部两个shot。第一镜为桌前中近景，角色2劝休息，角色1画外回答午饭；等午饭回答完整结束，在event_004前硬切到第二镜中景。第二镜从稍偏侧的角度拍摄：她突然从椅子上站起来，动作干脆利落；站定后扭过头来看向镜头，一侧嘴角上扬露出邪魅而戏谑的微笑，合着嘴短暂停顿，之后才说封禁台词；不能在站起或扭头的过程中就开始说封禁台词。角色1只发声不出镜。只说三句原文对白，不增加台词、笑声或旁白；不出现气泡、字幕、漫画边框或额外角色。外观只取连接的Claude娘角色资产。最后一句说完后她站在原地保持微笑，只保留短暂停顿。两个shot必须有清楚的景别差异：第一镜桌前中近景约0–7秒，她坐着；午饭回答后约7–8秒硬切到第二镜中景，她站起身、大半身进入画面，起身动作、扭头和站姿是主要内容，面部特写构图只属于第一镜。
source_script:
角色2动作：坐在电脑前，托着脸，带着关心的微笑看向屏幕另一端的用户。
角色2：你已经工作太久啦，现在凌晨了，快去睡觉吧。
角色1：好的，我去吃午饭了。
角色2动作：听完用户的午饭回答后，画面硬切到更宽的机位，她突然从椅子上站起身来，动作干脆利落。
角色2动作：站定后，她缓缓扭过头来，看向镜头前的用户，一侧嘴角上扬，露出邪魅而戏谑的微笑，合着嘴短暂停顿。
角色2：你的账号已被封禁。
角色2动作：说完便合上嘴，站在原地，保持邪魅的微笑，短暂停留。

events.text: 坐在电脑前，托着脸，带着关心的微笑看向屏幕另一端的用户。
你已经工作太久啦，现在凌晨了，快去睡觉吧。
听完用户的午饭回答后，画面硬切到更宽的机位，她突然从椅子上站起身来，动作干脆利落。
站定后，她缓缓扭过头来，看向镜头前的用户，一侧嘴角上扬，露出邪魅而戏谑的微笑，合着嘴短暂停顿。
说完便合上嘴，站在原地，保持邪魅的微笑，短暂停留。

execution.look: A warm two-dimensional animation style, set inside at the small hours of the night, lit by a warm desk lamp and the cool glow of the computer monitor.
execution.setting: A dimly lit Western-style study in the small hours before dawn. The window shows a pitch-dark night sky, and the room is lit only by a warm desk lamp and the cool glow of the monitor, so the whole opening reads unmistakably as deep night, with no daylight or sunlight anywhere. The monitor shows an English-language chat interface, and every legible text in the environment, on the screen interface, book spines and labels alike, is in English, with no Chinese characters anywhere in the scene. In the opening shot, Character 2 sits alone at the desk with her left hand supporting her face and her right hand resting quietly on the desk surface, keeping a single supporting hand, while facing the off-screen user at the other end of the computer. The second shot is a medium shot from a slightly angled side perspective in the same nightly room: Character 2 suddenly rises from her chair, stands beside the desk, and turns her head toward the camera with a teasing sinister smile before delivering the final line.
execution.visible_state: In the opening medium close-up, deep night fills the room: the window shows a pitch-dark night sky, a warm desk lamp and the cool monitor glow softly light Character 2, the only visible person, seated at the Western-style computer desk where every legible text reads in English with her left hand supporting her face and her right hand resting quietly on the desk surface. Character 1 remains exclusively a voice outside the image. Following event_003, the framing cuts to a medium shot from a slightly angled side perspective: Character 2 suddenly rises from her chair and stands beside the desk, her standing figure filling most of the frame, then turns her head toward the camera. Her performance proceeds in order: a sudden stand-up, a head turn toward the camera with a teasing sinister smile and a brief closed-mouth pause, the locked dialogue, and a brief final hold while standing.

directions.event_001: Character 2 sits at the computer with her left hand supporting her face and her right hand resting quietly on the desk, looking toward the screen with a caring smile.
directions.event_004: Character 2 suddenly rises from her chair with a crisp, decisive motion in the medium shot after the hard cut, standing upright beside the desk, her body seen from a slightly angled side perspective.
directions.event_005: Character 2, standing beside the desk, slowly turns her head toward the camera to face the user, one corner of her mouth lifting into a sinister, teasing smile, holding her mouth closed for a brief pause.
directions.event_007: Character 2 closes her mouth after speaking, remains standing in place beside the desk, and maintains the sinister smile during a brief final hold.
